text: When the prima donna storms out of a rehearsal of Verdi's Macbeth at the Parma Opera House, her understudy Betty steps into the role among live ravens on stage. A masked figure begins killing around her, binding Betty and [taping needles beneath her eyes|images|weapons and tools] so she must watch each murder. The killer resembles a figure from her childhood nightmares, and the truth leads back to [her dead mother's crimes|wrong|sins of the ancestors] and [a man obsessed with her face|wants|a lover to possess].
